title: How to Bulk Import Members Using CSV Spreadsheets

sections.heading: CSV Member Import Tool
sections.content:
To import existing member databases into Brilliant Directories:
1. Go to My Members > Import Members.
2. Download the official CSV Template with pre-formatted column headers (First Name, Last Name, Company, Email, Phone, Address, Category).
3. Upload your completed CSV file.
4. Map any custom columns to Brilliant Directories database fields.
5. Select the target Membership Plan for the imported users.
6. Click 'Start Import'.

procedural_steps: Navigate to My Members > Import Members
full_text:
CSV Member Import Tool
To import existing member databases into Brilliant Directories:
1. Go to My Members > Import Members.
2. Download the official CSV Template with pre-formatted column headers (First Name, Last Name, Company, Email, Phone, Address, Category).
3. Upload your completed CSV file.
4. Map any custom columns to Brilliant Directories database fields.
5. Select the target Membership Plan for the imported users.
6. Click 'Start Import'.
